issues.what: Ur III keyframe snap at -2100 (Cliopatria's Gutian outline) drops the Diyala valley (77 cells, Eshnunna's land) that the dossier's own ledger line (gain Akkad and Diyala, -2100) and the keyframe text give to Ur-Nammu; Diyala stayed nobody's until the -2049 tribute belt.

After the reunification of Egypt (-2033) the Nile valley at Siut/Asyut was broken by nobody's cells (a hole in the Middle Kingdom for -2033..-2001, kept by every later Middle Kingdom keyframe, which are the same Cliopatria shape); Siut had been the buffer province between Thebes and Heracleopolis.

Two-cell detached speckle of the Theban kingdom at Siut (27.2 N 31.4 E and 27.1 N 31.1 E), left by Cliopatria's Upper Egypt strip minus the Asyut governorate, against the dossier's 'short of Siut'; it reappears in the Middle Kingdom through the founding region, so it needs a keyframe override for -2061..-2056 and a loss event for -2055.
Ur III keyframe has Susiana from -2100 while the ledger takes Susa in -2094 (Ur-Nammu's last year); the page does not date the conquest within his reign ('before going on to conquer Susa').

Ur III snap also removes 438 cells that the gazetteer's Sumer/Akkad regions gave it (An-Najaf 113, Al-Muthannia 196, Al-Basrah 67, Dhi-Qar 21, Al-Qadisiyyah 20: desert and marsh provinces outside Cliopatria's settled outline); the outline is the better shape.
Elam snap at -2100 (265 cells, Khuzestan 217) follows from Ur III holding Susiana; consistent with Ur III keyframe.

Upper Egypt snap at -2061 (75 cells removed, mostly the Aswan, New Valley and Red Sea governorates' desert) is the gazetteer's Aswan governorate overshooting the Nile strip; the keyframe strip is right.
Isin snap at -2008 (20 added, 13 removed) is small; Isin has a detached south-east blob of 28 cells from the Cliopatria -2000 outline.

Size-rule conflict longshan-culture / xia-dynasty (147 cell-years, Henan): the Xia dossier draws a small central-Henan state ('direct Xia jurisdiction was limited to a small area') inside the Longshan culture's area; the smaller state rightly wins.
Conflict eshnunna / isin (1 cell, Diyala, -2008): smaller state wins, nothing to do.

After the patch the Diyala cells are direct Ur III land -2100..-2050 and flip to the vassal tint at -2049 (ledger/4 tribute belt), 79 cells; the Ur III page puts the Diyala garrisons in the peripheral zone only 'from the reign of Shulgi'.
At -2004 the 158 eastern periphery cells of Ur III (Wasit-east, Ilam, Kohgiluyeh and Buyer Ahmad) go to nobody; the next window's elam_-2000 keyframe will pull the Elamite part back.

problems: Middle Kingdom keyframes middle-kingdom-of-egypt_-2000, _-1944, _-1839 and _-1800 (and the founding region of its L0 and its keyframe _-2055) all derive from the same Cliopatria outlines; the Siut valley and the two Siut speckle cells are in the -2000 outline, so no snap re-breaks the valley after the patch (below the 20-cell threshold), but the later windows should re-check Asyut.
